name: us-salary
title: US full-time salary (USD/yr, before tax)
description: Usual earnings of full-time wage and salary workers aged 16+, Q2 2026 (120.9M workers). BLS publishes weekly figures; annual = weekly x 52. Covers the 10th-90th percentiles; values outside that range use a fitted Pareto tail, so treat very high salaries as estimates.
